top_needs.title: Practice efficiency gains and ROI with DM-monitored braces and aligners versus standard recall
top_needs.brands_and_products: Damon, ormco, KLOwen, Spark, Angel, Invisalign, clearcorrect, suresmile, Lightforce, self-ligating braces, Twin brackets, SmartSTL
top_needs.metrics_sought: chair time reduction, appointment frequency, ROI, profitability, time saving, visit reduction, rentability, ongoing monitoring costs vs benefits, practice optimisation, staff efficiency, diary changes, staff satisfaction, emergencies decrease, adaptive aligner change, average visit reduction
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors are skeptical that DM will actually save them time or money, or that it will reduce the number of in-person appointments. Some believe the workflow changes are not worth the investment, or that the ROI is unclear, especially for braces cases.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: No format preference specified — reps asked for any available evidence
sample_queries: How much chair time reduction achieved
How can I make DM work in a practice with 8 chairs and 15 assistants in a way that they really get the real benefits and make it work financially as well in The Netherlands?
Could you provide any data demonstrating improved patient compliance with DM or its impact on patient outcomes
Are Damon brackets more efficient than other brands?
Show how can doctors increases the profitability if their practices using DM
top_needs.gap_assessment: There is a need for robust, region-specific ROI and efficiency data, especially for non-aligner appliances and multi-location practices. Comparative studies with standard recall protocols are limited.

top_needs.title: Accuracy and reliability of DM’s AI for clinical observations and remote monitoring
top_needs.brands_and_products: SmartSTL, Spark, Damon, Invisalign, self-ligating braces
top_needs.metrics_sought: AI accuracy, specificity and sensitivity, class I goal, occlusal assessment, accuracy of scanning, AI versus orthodontist, FDA application, passivity archwires, aligner unseat tracking
top_needs.doctor_objections: Doctors question whether DM’s AI can reliably detect clinical issues, match orthodontist judgment, or be trusted for remote diagnosis. Some are concerned about regulatory validation and real-world accuracy.
top_needs.evidence_type_needed: academic publication, white paper, peer-reviewed, clinical study
sample_queries: Information on the accuracy of DM, a patient has questioned the ability of the AI to detect clinical observations
Specificity and sensitivity results for FDA application

Occlusal Assessment: A quantitative study validating the AI’s accuracy in detecting malocclusions (midline deviation, overbite, overjet, and canine relationship) found that the mean bias across all parameters was less than 0.5 mm, confirming its reliability as a remote diagnosis and triage tool.
How accurate is DentalMonitorings AI and will it save me money

I am looking for high AI accuracy in remote monitoring of aligner treatments, with precise evaluation of tooth movement, better case control, and optimization of clinical workflow to reduce chair time.
top_needs.gap_assessment: More peer-reviewed, head-to-head studies comparing AI to orthodontist assessments and regulatory submissions (e.g., FDA) are needed. Evidence for specific clinical scenarios (e.g., archwire passivity) is sparse.
